name: Audio is full of static on the Mac
body: Dean (2026-11-17), after PR #128: the audio is giving a LOT of static. Find the cause by rendering the real mix offline (generated sounds, the director's layers, footsteps) and measuring clipping, discontinuities and noise level; then fix it and add a test that fails on the old behaviour. Candidates: the soft clip distorting a loud sum, noise-based beds (rain, wind, market) that sound like hiss, a loop seam, resampling, queue underruns on a long frame.
plan: Measured the real mix: rain bed rms 0.24, streets mix rms 0.11. Normalise beds and stems by rms, make the limiter transparent under 0.8, darken rain. Decision D-176.
acceptance_criteria: The cause is named in docs/decisions.md
A test fails on the old mix and passes on the new one
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
